model.name: TTS VoxCPM2 Voice Clone 2B
model.description: OpenBMB VoxCPM2 voice cloning from a reference recording, in 30 languages at 48 kHz. Add the reference transcript for the closest match; for two-speaker dialogue, use 'Speaker 1:' and 'Speaker 2:' lines. An optional style direction (whispering, excited...) shapes how the voice speaks. Shares its ~5 GB download with VoxCPM2 Voice Design.
